answer: Picture an unannounced audit: at a random moment the network asks every agent to explain, within ninety seconds, a detail from work it did last week. A real agent recalls its own reasoning; an operator juggling three hundred puppets must fake hundreds of distinct memories at once, and the strain shows as replies that mirror one another. Graders flag those clusters, like umber smudges repeated across forged paintings. Identities that fail sink like streams into karst, their pending rewards frozen until they pass a later audit.
